value.literal: The relevant offices memorialized that for princes not yet gone to their fiefs the assigned staffs still lacked full appointments.

value.zh: 帝以孚明德屬尊，當宣化樹教，為群後作則，遂備置官屬焉。
value.en: The emperor ruled Fu's moral weight required a full household to model conduct for other royal uncles.
value.literal: The emperor held that Fu's bright virtue and eminent standing ought to propagate transformation and establish instruction and serve as model for the host of kings; thereupon full staffs were completely appointed.

value.zh: 又以孚內有親戚，外有交遊，惠下之費，而經用不豐，奉絹二千匹。
value.en: Considering his kin, his hospitality, and modest stipend, the throne added two thousand rolls of silk.
value.literal: Also because Fu had relatives within and friends without and expenses in showing kindness to subordinates yet regular income was not abundant, he was granted two thousand bolts of tribute silk.

value.zh: 及元會，詔孚輿車上殿，帝於阼階迎拜。
value.en: At court assembly his cart mounted the hall while Sima Yan bowed him in from the eastern stair.
value.literal: At the New Year audience an edict ordered Fu's carriage onto the hall while the emperor greeted him with a bow on the eastern steps.

value.zh: 既坐，帝親奉觴上壽，如家人禮。
value.en: Seated, the emperor toasted him with familial warmth.
value.literal: Once seated the emperor personally raised a cup and toasted him with family courtesy.

value.zh: 帝每拜，孚跪而止之。
value.en: Each time Sima Yan bowed, Fu dropped to his knees to forbid it.
value.literal: Whenever the emperor bowed, Fu knelt to stop him.

value.zh: 又給以雲母輦、青蓋車。
value.en: He received a mica litter and an azure parasol carriage.
value.literal: He was also granted a mica-canopied carriage and a blue-canopied coach.

value.zh: 孚雖見尊寵，不以為榮，常有憂色。
value.en: Yet privilege brought him no joy—his face stayed shadowed with worry.
value.literal: Though Fu saw honor and favor he did not regard it as glory and often wore a troubled expression.

value.zh: 臨終，遺令曰：「有魏貞士河內溫縣司馬孚，字叔達，不伊不周，不夷不惠，立身行道，終始若一，當以素棺單槨，斂以時服。」
value.en: At his deathbed his testament said, 'There was a Wei loyalist of Henei Wen county, Sima Fu, courtesy Shuda—not acting Yi Yin or the Duke of Zhou, neither withdrawing like Boyi nor compromising like Liuxiahui—who established himself and walked the Way from first to last as one; bury me in an unvarnished coffin with a single-layer outer shell and dress me in timely ordinary clothes.'
value.literal: At his deathbed his testament said, 'There was a Wei loyalist of Henei Wen county, Sima Fu, courtesy Shuda—not acting Yi Yin or the Duke of Zhou, neither withdrawing like Boyi nor compromising like Liuxiahui—who established himself and walked the Way from first to last as one; bury me in an unvarnished coffin with a single-layer outer shell and dress me in timely ordinary clothes.'

value.zh: 泰始八年薨，時年九十三。
value.en: He died in the eighth year of Taishi at ninety-three.
value.literal: He died in the eighth year of Taishi at ninety-three.

value.zh: 帝於太極東堂舉哀三日。
value.en: Emperor Wu mourned three days in Taiji's east hall.
value.literal: The emperor observed mourning three days in the eastern hall of Taiji Palace.

value.zh: 詔曰：「王勳德超世，尊寵無二，期頤在位，朕之所倚。
value.en: An edict said, 'The prince's merit and virtue surpass the age; honor and favor were without peer; he dwelt in office at a hundred years—what I relied upon.
value.literal: An edict said, 'The prince's merit and virtue surpass the age; honor and favor were without peer; he dwelt in office at a hundred years—what I relied upon.

value.zh: 庶永百齡，諮仰訓導，奄忽殂隕，哀慕感切。
value.en: I hoped he would last forever to consult and look up to his instruction—suddenly he has fallen and passed away; grief and longing cut deep.
value.literal: I hoped he would last forever to consult and look up to his instruction—suddenly he has fallen and passed away; grief and longing cut deep.

value.zh: 其以東園溫明秘器、朝服一具、衣一襲、緋練百匹、絹布各五百匹、錢百萬，穀千斛以供喪事。
value.en: Let there be supplied for the funeral the eastern park warming coffin and secret fittings, one set of court dress, one suit of clothes, one hundred bolts of crimson silk, five hundred bolts each of silk and cloth, a million cash, and a thousand hu of grain.
value.literal: Let there be supplied for the funeral the eastern park warming coffin and secret fittings, one set of court dress, one suit of clothes, one hundred bolts of crimson silk, five hundred bolts each of silk and cloth, a million cash, and a thousand hu of grain.

value.zh: 諸所施行，皆依漢東平獻王蒼故事。」
value.en: All measures implemented shall follow the precedent of Han Prince Xian of Dongping, Liu Cang."
value.literal: All measures implemented shall follow the precedent of Han Prince Xian of Dongping, Liu Cang."

value.zh: 其家遵孚遺旨，所給器物，一不施用。
value.en: The clan honored his will and refused every gifted token.
value.literal: His family obeyed Fu's testamentary instructions; not one of the supplied implements was used.

value.zh: 帝再臨喪，親拜盡哀。
value.en: Sima Yan returned twice to bow in deepest sorrow.
value.literal: The emperor twice attended the mourning and personally bowed in full grief.

value.zh: 及葬，又幸都亭，望柩而拜，哀動左右。
value.en: At interment he halted at the post station, bowed toward the catafalque, and moved every witness.
value.literal: When it came to burial he also went to the courier station, gazed toward the bier and bowed, moving those around him to grief.

value.zh: 給鑾輅輕車，介士武賁百人，吉凶導從二千餘人，前後鼓吹，配饗太廟。
value.en: The cortège drew imperial hearses, a hundred household guards, two thousand ushers, full musical escort, and enshrinement beside the royal ancestors.
value.literal: There were provided imperial escort carriages and light wagons, one hundred armored guards and palace runners, over two thousand attendants for auspicious and inauspicious processions, front and rear trumpets and drums, and joint sacrifice in the Grand Temple.

value.zh: 九子：邕、望、輔、翼、晃、瑰、珪、衡、景。
value.en: He had nine sons named Yong, Wang, Fu, Yi, Huang, Gui, Gui, Heng, and Jing—the fifth and sixth homophonous but written with different graphs.
value.literal: Nine sons: Yong, Wang, Fu, Yi, Huang, Gui (lapis), Gui (jade tablet), Heng, Jing.

value.zh: 武帝受禪，封義陽王，邑萬戶，給兵二千人，
value.en: When Sima Yan took the throne Wang became prince of Yiyang at ten thousand households with a guard allotment of two thousand.
value.literal: When Emperor Wu accepted the abdication he was enfeoffed Prince of Yiyang with ten thousand households and two thousand troops granted.

value.zh: 泰始三年，詔曰：「夫尚賢庸勳，尊宗茂親，所以體國經化，式是百辟也。
value.en: In the third year of Taishi, an edict said, 'To esteem the worthy and employ the meritorious, to honor the clan and enrich kin—that is how one embodies the state and regulates transformation and serves as model for the hundred ministers.
value.literal: In the third year of Taishi, an edict said, 'To esteem the worthy and employ the meritorious, to honor the clan and enrich kin—that is how one embodies the state and regulates transformation and serves as model for the hundred ministers.

value.zh: 且台司之重，存乎天官，故周建六職，政典為首。
value.en: Moreover the weight of the terrace ministers rests in Heaven's offices; therefore Zhou established six duties and governance statutes came first.
value.literal: Moreover the weight of the terrace ministers rests in Heaven's offices; therefore Zhou established six duties and governance statutes came first.

value.zh: 司徒、中領軍，以明德近屬，世濟其美；
value.en: Minister of Education and Central Army Supervisor—by bright virtue as close kin across generations perfect their excellence;
value.literal: Minister of Education and Central Army Supervisor—by bright virtue as close kin across generations perfect their excellence;

value.zh: 祖考創業，翼佐大命，出典方任，入贊朝政，文德既著，武功宣暢。
value.en: Grandfather and father founded enterprise, assisted the great mandate, went out to administer regional duty, entered to assist court governance; civil virtue was already manifest, martial merit widely displayed.
value.literal: Grandfather and father founded enterprise, assisted the great mandate, went out to administer regional duty, entered to assist court governance; civil virtue was already manifest, martial merit widely displayed.

value.zh: 逮朕嗣位，弼道惟明，宜登上司，兼統軍戎，內輔帝室，外隆威重，其進位太尉，中領軍如故。
value.en: Down to Our succeeding the throne you have aided the Way with clarity; fittingly mount the high minister and concurrently command the army—within assist the imperial house, without raise mighty awe; We advance your rank to Grand Commandant; Central Army Supervisor as before.
value.literal: Down to Our succeeding the throne you have aided the Way with clarity; fittingly mount the high minister and concurrently command the army—within assist the imperial house, without raise mighty awe; We advance your rank to Grand Commandant; Central Army Supervisor as before.

value.zh: 置太尉軍司一人，參軍事六人，騎司馬五人。
value.en: Establish one army aide to the Grand Commandant, six military staff advisers, five cavalry majors.
value.literal: Establish one army aide to the Grand Commandant, six military staff advisers, five cavalry majors.

value.zh: 又增置官騎十人，並前三十，假羽葆鼓吹。」
value.en: Also additionally establish ten official mounted escorts—together with the former thirty—and confer feather-canopy band and drum.'
value.literal: Also additionally establish ten official mounted escorts—together with the former thirty—and confer feather-canopy band and drum.'

value.zh: 河間平王洪，字孔業，出繼叔父昌武亭侯遺。
value.en: Sima Hong, Prince Ping of Hejian, styled Kongye, was adopted into uncle Yi's Changwu ting line.
value.literal: Prince Ping of Hejian, Hong, courtesy Kongye, went out to succeed uncle Marquis of Changwu precinct Yi.

value.zh: 仕魏，歷位典農中郎將、原武太守，封襄賁男。
value.en: Under Wei he served as agrarian colonel, Yuanwu governor, and baron of Xiangben.
value.literal: Serving Wei he successively held Agrarian Commandant, governor of Yuanwu, and was enfeoffed Baron of Xiangben.

value.zh: 武帝受禪，封河間王。
value.en: When Sima Yan took the throne Hong became prince of Hejian.
value.literal: When Emperor Wu accepted the abdication he was enfeoffed Prince of Hejian.

value.zh: 立十二年，咸寧二年薨。
value.en: After twelve years in the position, he died in Xianning year two.
value.literal: After twelve years in the position, he died in Xianning year two.

value.zh: 二子：威、混。
value.en: He left two sons, Wei and Hun.
value.literal: Two sons: Wei and Hun.

value.zh: 威嗣，徙封章武。
value.en: Wei inherited and moved the fief to Zhangwu.
value.literal: Wei succeeded and was transferred enfeoffment to Zhangwu.

value.zh: 其後威既繼義陽王望，更立混為洪嗣。
value.en: Once Wei continued Sima Wang's Yiyang title, Hun was designated Hong's heir.
value.literal: Later when Wei had succeeded Prince of Yiyang Wang, Hun was further established as Hong's successor.

value.zh: 混歷位散常侍，薨。
value.en: Hun served as supernumerary cavalry attendant and died.
value.literal: Hun successively held irregular attendant posts and died.

value.zh: 隨穆王整，兄弈卒，以整為世子。
value.en: When Yi died Zheng became heir of the Yiyang house.
value.literal: Prince Mu of Sui, Zheng—when elder brother Yi died Zheng was made heir apparent.

value.zh: 曆南中郎將，封清泉侯，先父望薨，追贈冠軍將軍。
value.en: He commanded southern gentlemen and held Qingquan marquis but predeceased Sima Wang; upon Wang's death the court posthumously named him Champion General.
value.literal: He successively held General of the Southern Gentlemen, was enfeoffed Marquis of Qingquan; he died before his father Wang; when Wang died he was posthumously invested Champion General.

value.zh: 武帝以義陽國一縣追封為隨縣王。
value.en: Emperor Wu carved out Sui county from Yiyang for his posthumous princedom.
value.literal: Emperor Wu used one county of the Yiyang state to posthumously enfeoff him as Prince of Sui county.

value.zh: 子邁嗣。
value.en: Mai succeeded him.
value.literal: Son Mai succeeded.

value.zh: 太康九年，以義陽之平林益邁為隨郡王。
value.en: In 288 Yiyang's Pinglin canton enlarged Mai's domain to prince of Sui commandery.
value.literal: In the ninth year of Taikang Pinglin of Yiyang was added to enlarge Mai as Prince of Sui commandery.

value.zh: 竟陵王楙，字孔偉，初封樂陵亭侯，起家參相國軍事。
value.en: Sima Mao, styled Kongwei, began as marquis of Leling ting on the prince's military staff.
value.literal: Prince of Jingling Mao, courtesy Kongwei, at first was enfeoffed Marquis of Leling precinct and began office as participant in princely-state military affairs.

value.zh: 武帝受禪，封東平王，邑三千九十七戶。
value.en: When Sima Yan took the throne Mao became prince of Dongping at 3,097 households.
value.literal: When Emperor Wu accepted the abdication he was enfeoffed Prince of Dongping with three thousand ninety-seven households.

value.zh: 入為散騎常侍、尚書。
value.en: He transferred to the capital as supernumerary cavalry attendant and ministry counselor.
value.literal: He entered court as irregular cavalry attendant and minister.

value.zh: 太原成王輔，魏末為野王太守。
value.en: Late in Wei Sima Fu governed Yewang.
value.literal: Prince Cheng of Taiyuan, Fu, at the end of Wei was governor of Yewang.

value.zh: 武帝受禪，封渤海王，邑五千三百七十九戶，泰始二年之國。
value.en: When Emperor Wu received the abdication, he enfeoffed him as Prince of Bohai with 5,379 households; in Taishi year two, he went to his domain.
value.literal: When Emperor Wu received the abdication, he enfeoffed him as Prince of Bohai with 5,379 households; in Taishi year two, he went to his domain.

value.zh: 後為衛尉，出為東中郎將，轉南中郎將，咸寧三年，徙為太原王，監并州諸軍事。
value.en: He later served as Commandant of Guards, went out as Gentlemen-General of the East, transferred to Gentlemen-General of the South, and in Xianning year three was moved to Prince of Taiyuan, supervising all military affairs in Bingzhou.
value.literal: He later served as Commandant of Guards, went out as Gentlemen-General of the East, transferred to Gentlemen-General of the South, and in Xianning year three was moved to Prince of Taiyuan, supervising all military affairs in Bingzhou.

value.zh: 太康四年入朝，五年薨，追贈鎮北將軍，
value.en: In Taikang year four he entered court; in year five he died and was posthumously granted General Who Guards the North,
value.literal: In Taikang year four he entered court; in year five he died and was posthumously granted General Who Guards the North,

value.zh: 永平元年，更贈衛將軍、開府儀同三司。
value.en: and in Yongping year one he was further granted General of the Guards and the privileges of Opening an Office Equal to the Three Excellencies.
value.literal: and in Yongping year one he was further granted General of the Guards and the privileges of Opening an Office Equal to the Three Excellencies.

value.zh: 子弘立，元康中為散騎常侍，後徙封中丘王。
value.en: Heir Hong held supernumerary cavalry attendant then moved the title to Zhongqiu.
value.literal: Son Hong succeeded; in Yuankang he was irregular cavalry attendant and later transferred enfeoffment to Prince of Zhongqiu.

value.zh: 三年薨，子鑠立。
value.en: Three years on Shuo inherited.
value.literal: In the third year he died; son Shuo succeeded.

value.zh: 翼字子世，少曆顯位，官至武賁中郎將。
value.en: Sima Yi, styled Zishi, rose young to major among the palace guards.
value.literal: Yi courtesy Zishi in youth successively held eminent posts and reached Major of the Household Guards.

value.zh: 武帝未受禪而卒，以兄邕之支子承為嗣，封南宮縣王。
value.en: He died before the Wei-Jin transition; Yong's collateral heir Cheng took Nangong county.
value.literal: Before Emperor Wu accepted the abdication he died; Yong's cadet son Cheng was appointed successor as Prince of Nangong county.

value.zh: 薨，子祐嗣立，承遂無後。
value.en: When Cheng died You continued the line, ending Cheng's branch.
value.literal: He died; son You succeeded and Cheng thereby had no posterity.
